purpose: Looks up the holder's existing records of a name as they type, before a new one is made.
namedChanges: The imports are the peers `person-create`, `stakeholder-card-vocabulary`, `stakeholder-card-model`, `contact-kind-model`, `ontology-reads`, `pick-or-create`, `plan-record-hooks`, `record-types` and `id-tail`, and the third-party `@tanstack/react-query` and `react`; `./stakeholderNoun`, `./sameLabel`, `./IdTail` and `./useStakeholderCreate` are the unit's own.

`import type { CreateMode } from "./CreateModeChooser"` is the type `CreateMode` written in the unit (the same five strings); `FOLDER_TYPE_ID` (`"folder"`) is a private constant; `BaseSession` is the exported interface `StakeholderFindSession` (`principal: string`).

The interface `StakeholderFindHost` is added and exported, and `UseStakeholderCreateArgs` gets `host: StakeholderFindHost`; `useStakeholderNoun(inStakeholders && open)` is `useStakeholderNoun(host.vocabulary, inStakeholders && open)`; `stakeholderCardVocabularyQuery()` is `stakeholderCardVocabularyQuery(host.vocabulary)`; `defaultWriteVaultId(` is `host.defaultWriteVaultId(`; `recordPerson(` and `afterRecordPerson(` take `host.person` as their first argument.
`useStakeholderNoun` (stakeholderNoun.ts) takes the vocabulary host as its first argument and passes it to `stakeholderCardVocabularyQuery(host)`; `sameLabel.ts` and `IdTail.tsx` are the source.
Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, a person, a ruling or the host app are reworded; no code changed. No string literal carries a tag.
